    What services do you offer?
    Maid services, deep cleaning, move in/move out cleaning, carpet cleaning, rug cleaning, upholstery cleaning, tile & grout cleaning, window cleaning and eco/green cleaning. We clean from inside to outdoors — and campers too.
    Which areas do you serve?
    We serve Groton, Connecticut. If you’re nearby and not sure whether you’re covered, give us a call and ask.
    Can you come on short notice or weekends?
    We aim to help no matter what time or day — whether you’re heading out of town or have a get-together coming up. Call or text to check availability for your date.
    How much does a cleaning cost?
    Every home and job is different, so pricing depends on the size of the space and the services you choose. Send a quote request or call and we’ll put together a price for you. Ask about 10% off general cleanings.*
    Do you offer eco-friendly cleaning?
    Yes — eco/green cleaning is one of our services. Let us know in your request if you’d prefer it.
